properties.name: reflow2's repository moved from github.com/sligara7 to github.com/flo2-connector, and every live reference to its address follows
properties.rationale:
WHY NOW, WITH A REDIRECT IN PLACE: a redirect is GitHub's courtesy, not a contract. It holds only while nobody creates a new repository at the old name, and every instruction that names the old address teaches the next reader to depend on it.

LEFT ON PURPOSE:
- The container image. release.yml names it ghcr.io/<lowercased $GITHUB_REPOSITORY>/reflow2-mcp, so every image up to and including 0.78.0 exists ONLY under ghcr.io/sligara7/reflow2/reflow2-mcp. Pointing the docs at ghcr.io/flo2-connector now would name an address with no images in it. The next release cut publishes under the new name and moves these lines then: getting-started/UPDATING.md (three lines, docker pull, docker run and the digest pin), docker/publish-index.sh's usage example, and tools/test_release_workflow.py's IMG fixture (an arbitrary value; moving it is cosmetic). req:reflow2-consumable-as-an-image's statement names the ghcr address too.
- History: CHANGELOG entries for released versions, docs/upgrading-to-v0.13.0.md and v0.22.0.md, and what Decisions, Requirements, TemporalFacts and Releases in this design recorded at the time (issue links, run sources, quoted words). They were true when written; GitHub redirects their links.
- Repositories that did not move stay under github.com/sligara7: dynograph-foundation, storyflow, dev_storyflow, reflow, chain_reflow, embeddings-rs, integrated_reflow, IfcOpenShell.

OPEN: dec:where-the-reflow2-plugin-marketplace-lives (proposed) still quotes `claude plugin marketplace add sligara7/reflow2` as an option's command. It is an open choice in the owner's hands, so its text was not edited; whoever settles it should read the address as flo2-connector/reflow2.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: On 2026-10-03 Anthony moved reflow2 (with flo2, flo2-cad, flo2-ifc and dev_reflow2) from github.com/sligara7 to the github.com/flo2-connector organization, and asked for a small PR per repository updating its addresses. GitHub redirects the old address. This change moves every live reference: the install line (README, getting-started/README.md, SETUP.md, UPDATING.md, docs/collaborating.md, the ci-gate skill's workflow example), install.sh's default REFLOW2_REPO, reflow2_init.py's upstream remote, reflow2_install.py's no-binary message, the dependency checker's user agent, Cargo.toml's repository, detect.rs's doc links, the report-friction skill's gh issue commands, AGENTS.md, docs/overview.md, COORD.md's PR links, env:ci's location and the planned plugin capability's marketplace commands.
